name: shift-card
title: Shift Card
description: A profile card that shows a large portrait at rest and, on hover, moves the photo into a small avatar while the name, bio, follower counts and Follow button slide up.
use: Introduce a person with a portrait and let their bio and stats appear without leaving the page.
avoid: Hover is required to read the bio, so touch and keyboard users only get the portrait and name.
a11y: Bio and stats open only on pointer hover; the card has no focus handling, so keyboard users cannot reach the details or Follow button. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall dark rounded card. Its top strip pairs a green dot and Open to work with Design Engineer; a large rounded portrait sits centred above the name and an arrow. Hovered, the photo becomes a small corner avatar and dense text fills the lower half.
behaves: Hovering shrinks the portrait into the top-left corner and expands a bottom panel to reveal bio, location, counts and a Follow button; leaving reverses it after a short delay.
customise: Four node props fill the top strip, portrait, hover avatar and bottom panel; card width, height and hover timing are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One portrait image and a few layout and height animations on hover.
demo: Sofia Marquez, Design Engineer, Lisbon, ex-Figma and ex-Linear, 4.2k followers, 318 following.
issues: Bio, stats and Follow button are unreachable by keyboard; they exist only on hover.
On touch, a tap opens the panel and immediately closes it, so the details flash.
The card shows a pointer cursor and arrow but is not a link.
polishWhy: The portrait-to-avatar morph is convincing; hover-only details and a dead arrow keep it from 5.
